Deviload 2.7.3 thanks the people who support the project, right in the main window.

- A visible **Top supporters** board shows public Ko-fi names and links to the support page.
- The small supporter list is maintained manually and bundled with the app. It works offline and makes no network requests.
- Donation amounts, messages, email addresses and payment identifiers are not included in the public list or the desktop app.
- English, Russian and Spanish labels are included; supporter names stay exactly as names.
- A grateful pose of the current fiery mascot thanks supporters. The empty queue and download controls have matching card sizes on wide windows.
- Fixed the release publication command that failed when generating notes for 2.7.2.

Existing profiles and updater settings remain compatible. The macOS package remains an unsigned, unnotarized test build; follow the installation instructions in the README.

Full changelog: https://github.com/Pronexsteam/deviload/compare/v2.7.2...v2.7.3
